hero.title: File:Andrew and Mary Leon Memorial Headstone, Martyn Street Cemetery, Cairns, 2020.jpg
hero.source: Andrew and Mary Leon Memorial Headstone, Martyn Street Cemetery, Cairns, 2020
hero.description: The Leon Memorial headstone was installed to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Andrew Leon's death on 27 June 1920. His wife Mary died on 22 June 1922. Leon pioneered the Cairns area sugar industry with the Hap Wah plantation (1878-1886) and was a leader of Cairns early Chinese community from the 1870s into the 1890s. The Chinese writing translates as "Centenary anniversity of death, Cairns Chinese community leader and cane sugar industry pioneer"

gallery.title: File:Chinatown Cairns, circa 1890.jpg
gallery.credit: Chinatown Cairns, ca.1890. Retrieved on 1 December 2020.
gallery.description: Chinatown Cairns, circa 1890. The Crown Hotel (35 Shields Street) is  in the upper right of the photo. The street from left to right in front of the hotel was Sachs Street (now Grafton Street). The street running up to the right of the hotel is Shields Street. To the left of the hotel there is a building with 4 hortizontal gables with a flagpole in front, which is the Lit Sung Goong Temple (now 95 Grafton Street). The photo was taken from the roof of the Hides Hotel (87 Lakes Steet).
